name: Haiden Miles
source:
Haiden Miles is widely regarded as being friendly and outgoing by his peers. There's nothing bad you can really say about him. He's friendly? He's nice? He let you copy homework at the last minute so you didn't get yelled at??

[From in-game profile]

[spoiler]Despite that, Haiden has pretty awful depression to deal with, though Naomi's the only one that knows. Aside from his parents anyway. His other friends are clueless to the suicide attempt or the antidepressants he takes.

He tends to make friends as a distraction from his own issues, though he never expected the anxiety ridden 'weird kid" to be the one to make him face that he had a problem in the first place.

He's been raised to be incredibly accepting, even if it doesn't make sense to him at first. His mother is bisexual, so he's not much of a stranger to being 'outside the box".[/spoiler]
